gloss: outer skin; rind; husk; outer covering

definitions.explanation: the outermost layer or covering of a fruit, vegetable, seed, or other natural object
the outer protective layer of a structure, building, or manufactured product

examples.japanese: バナナの{外皮|がいひ}をむく。
examples.english: Peel the skin of a banana.

examples.japanese: この{果物|くだもの}は{外皮|がいひ}が{硬|かた}いので、ナイフが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: This fruit has a hard outer skin, so you need a knife.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎの{外皮|がいひ}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}いてから{調理|ちょうり}する。
examples.english: Remove the outer skin of the onion before cooking.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{外皮|がいひ}の{断熱性|だんねつせい}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: The insulation of a building's exterior envelope is important.

examples.japanese: {餃子|ぎょうざ}の{外皮|がいひ}がパリッとしている。
{住宅|じゅうたく}の{外皮|がいひ}{性能|せいのう}を{高|たか}めることで、{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}の{効率|こうりつ}が{大幅|おおはば}に{改善|かいぜん}される。
examples.english: By improving the building envelope performance of a house, heating and cooling efficiency improves significantly.

notes:
Composed of {外|がい} (outer; outside) + {皮|ひ} (skin; rind). Covers both natural coverings (fruit peels, seed husks) and man-made ones (building exteriors, food wrappers). In architecture and energy efficiency, {外皮|がいひ} is a technical term for a building's thermal envelope.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外皮|がいひ}をむく: to peel the outer skin
- {外皮|がいひ}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く: to remove the outer covering
- {建物|たてもの}の{外皮|がいひ}: building envelope
- {外皮|がいひ}{性能|せいのう}: envelope performance (thermal efficiency)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {皮|かわ}: skin; peel — the everyday word for skin or peel
- {表皮|ひょうひ}: epidermis; surface skin — specifically the outermost layer of skin (medical/botanical)
- {殻|から}: shell; husk — for hard outer coverings like eggs, nuts, shellfish
